class.name: Schema
class.brief_description: Validates data against JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 and Draft-07 specifications.
class.description: Validates Godot [Variant] data structures against [url=https://json-schema.org/]JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 and Draft-07[/url] specifications. JSON Schema is an industry-standard vocabulary for describing and validating JSON and structured data, commonly used for configuration validation, save-game integrity, API contracts, and editor tooling. This class automatically handles all core JSON Schema validation keywords including type checking, numeric constraints, string patterns, array items and tuples ([code]prefixItems[/code]), object properties, dependent schemas, unevaluated keywords ([code]unevaluatedProperties[/code], [code]unevaluatedItems[/code]), and logical composition. It supports schema references ([code]$ref[/code]), dynamic references ([code]$dynamicAnchor[/code], [code]$dynamicRef[/code]), external schema registration, and format validation. Schemas are represented as tree structures that can be navigated programmatically, making it ideal for building editors with auto-complete and inspection capabilities. All schemas are compiled lazily with thread-safe caching for optimal performance. [b]Note:[/b] Schemas with a [code]$id[/code] field are automatically registered globally when built with [method build_schema], allowing them to be referenced by other schemas.

method.name: build_schema
clear_registry
method.description: Clears registered schemas and compiled rule caches from the global schema registry. If [param preserve_metaschemas] is [code]true[/code] (default), default built-in meta-schemas (such as Draft 2020-12 and Draft-07 meta-schemas) remain registered while all user schemas are removed. If [code]false[/code], all schemas including meta-schemas are cleared. [codeblock] # Clear all user-registered schemas and rule caches Schema.clear_registry() [/codeblock]

method.name: get_at_path
get_child

get_comment
method.description:
Returns the Schema's [code]$comment[/code] if defined, or an empty string otherwise. [codeblock] var schema = Schema.build_schema({ "$comment": "This is a user Schema", "type": "object" })
print(Schema.get_comment()) # "This is a user Schema" [/codeblock]

method.name: get_compile_error_summary
get_compile_errors
get_custom_metadata
method.description: Returns the custom application metadata stored under [param key] on this schema node, or [code]null[/code] if the key does not exist. [codeblock] var schema = Schema.build_schema({"type": "string"}) schema.set_custom_metadata("ui_hint", "multiline_text") print(schema.get_custom_metadata("ui_hint")) # "multiline_text" [/codeblock]

method.name: get_id
method.description:
Returns the Schema's [code]$id[/code] if defined, or an empty string otherwise. [codeblock] var schema = Schema.build_schema({ "$id": "http://example.com/user.json", "type": "object" })
print(Schema.get_id()) # "http://example.com/user.json" [/codeblock]

method.name: get_item_count
get_item_schema
get_item_schemas
get_root
get_schema_definition
get_schema_from_registry
get_schema_type
method.description:
Returns the Schema type as a [enum SchemaType] constant. Types are automatically detected based on the Schema's keywords and structure. [codeblock] var obj_schema = Schema.build_schema({"type": "object", "properties": {}}) print(obj_schema.get_schema_type() == Schema.SCHEMA_OBJECT) # true
var arr_schema = Schema.build_schema({"type": "array", "items": {}}) print(arr_schema.get_schema_type() == Schema.SCHEMA_ARRAY) # true [/codeblock]

method.name: get_schema_type_name
method.description: Returns the Schema type as a human-readable string: [code]"Object"[/code], [code]"Array"[/code], [code]"Scalar"[/code], or [code]"Logical"[/code]. [codeblock] var schema = Schema.build_schema({"type": "string"}) print(schema.get_schema_type_name()) # "Scalar" [/codeblock]

method.name: get_schema_url
method.description:
Returns the Schema's [code]$schema[/code] if defined, or an empty string otherwise. [codeblock] var schema = Schema.build_schema({ "$schema": "http://example.com/user.json", "type": "object" })
print(Schema.get_schema_url()) # "http://example.com/user.json" [/codeblock]

method.name: get_title
method.description:
Returns the Schema's [code]title[/code] if defined, or an empty string otherwise. [codeblock] var schema = Schema.build_schema({ "title": "My Schema", "type": "object" })
print(Schema.get_title()) # "My Schema" [/codeblock]

method.name: has_child
has_children
has_custom_metadata
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if custom application metadata exists on this schema node for the given [param key]. [codeblock] if schema.has_custom_metadata("editor_icon"): display_icon(schema.get_custom_metadata("editor_icon")) [/codeblock]

method.name: is_array
is_assert_format
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [code]format[/code] keywords are enforced as validation assertions for this schema (or inherited from its root schema). If [code]false[/code], [code]format[/code] is treated as an informational annotation only (the default under JSON Schema Draft 2020-12).

method.name: is_default_format_assertion
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if format assertion is globally enabled by default for all schemas via [method set_default_format_assertion]. Default is [code]false[/code].

method.name: is_object
is_root
is_scalar
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this Schema validates scalar values (strings, numbers, booleans, null) rather than complex structures. [codeblock] var schema = Schema.build_schema({ "type": "string", "minLength": 1 }) print(schema.is_scalar()) # true [/codeblock]

method.name: is_schema_registered
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if a Schema with the given ID is registered in the global Schema registry. [codeblock] var schema = Schema.build_schema({ "$id": "http://example.com/user.json", "type": "object" })
print(Schema.is_schema_registered("http://example.com/user.json")) # true [/codeblock]

method.name: is_valid
load_from_json
load_from_json_file
register_schema
set_assert_format
method.description: Sets whether [code]format[/code] keywords are enforced as validation assertions for this schema. When [param enabled] is [code]true[/code], values that fail format validation (such as [code]"email"[/code], [code]"uri"[/code], [code]"date-time"[/code], [code]"uuid"[/code], etc.) produce validation errors. When [code]false[/code], formats act as annotations only. [codeblock] var schema = Schema.build_schema({ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "type": "string", "format": "email" }) schema.set_assert_format(true) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_custom_metadata
method.description: Attaches custom application-defined metadata to this schema node. Useful for storing editor hints, UI widgets, or serialization options alongside the schema structure. [codeblock] var schema = Schema.build_schema({"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 100}) schema.set_custom_metadata("widget", "slider") [/codeblock]

method.name: set_default_format_assertion
method.description: Configures the global default format validation behavior across all schemas. When set to [code]true[/code], all schemas will enforce [code]format[/code] keywords as assertions, including Draft 2020-12 schemas. When set to [code]false[/code] (default), Draft 2020-12 schemas treat format as an annotation unless individually configured with [param assert_format] or [method set_assert_format]. [codeblock] # Globally enable strict format validation Schema.set_default_format_assertion(true) [/codeblock]

method.name: unregister_schema
method.description:
Unregisters a Schema from the global registry. Returns [code]true[/code] if the Schema was found and removed, [code]false[/code] otherwise. [codeblock] Schema.build_schema({ "$id": "http://example.com/temp.json", "type": "string" })
# Later, clean up Schema.unregister_schema("http://example.com/temp.json") [/codeblock]

method.name: validate
